headlines.title: Hai lần bóng đá trẻ Việt Nam suýt thắng New Zealand ở World Cup: Tiếc nuối!
'A proud moment for Ngāti Rehua': New Zealand's longest lizard returns to Aotea Great Barrier Island
New Zealand Rugby re-sign possible future All Blacks coach
New Zealand rearguard holds India to draw first Test
Estonia's advice to New Zealand on dealing with Russia

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
New Zealand's longest lizard has returned to Aotea Great Barrier Island, described as a proud moment for Ngāti Rehua. [1]
Estonia has provided advice to New Zealand on dealing with Russia. [3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market on the Reserve Bank of New Zealand making no change to the official cash rate at the March meeting is priced Yes at 50% as of Nov 24, 2026, closing Mar 17, 2027. [E6]
A Kalshi market on National winning the next New Zealand general election is priced Yes at 38% as of Nov 24, 2026, closing Dec 31, 2027. [E7]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the Reserve Bank of New Zealand will make no change to the official cash rate at the March meeting. [E6]
Whether National will win the next New Zealand general election. [E7]
